theorems.name: Submission.ind_pi_ss_fatou_level_selection
theorems.statement: ∀ (g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (a b : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (E : Set ℝ), a < b → (∀ k, Measurable (g k)) → C < ∞ → (∀ k, ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, g k t ≤ C) → E.Countable → ∃ (γ : ℝ) (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (G : ℝ≥0∞), γ ∈ Ioo a b ∧ γ ∉ E ∧ StrictMono σ ∧ G < ∞ ∧ ∀ k, g (σ k) γ ≤ G
